We are up to 24 subscribers and this is without the need for any moderation at all as of late. (I do not know and can not opine on anything that predates my finding the sub.) I think, for such a small sub and so little publicity, that 24 subscribers is pretty good, actually. I noticed a total of 18 users on the sub at one time yesterday evening.

I do think it would be nice if the moderators were actively working to build the community but they may well be busy with more important things. I try to not assume the worst. I try to hope for the best. Usually it comes out somewhere in the middle.

Anyhow, I've noticed that the more content that gets posted the more people meander in off the street to see what's going on. Some of my best experiences are with an uninvited (but still wanted and accepted) guest so it's nice to see people wander in and check it out. Sometimes they even comment. Which is where I am going with this...

Yes, this is me attempting to goad you into action. I think that if more of us posted content, it needn't be daily or anything, and actually commented then things would be a lot nicer as the momentum would bring in additional users. Put yourself out there. What's the worst that can happen? If you see something interesting then post it. If you have a local paper then check it out for articles that interest you and post them. Start a discussion and spout gibberish.

If we want more content we're going to have to start by building content that people find interesting. At least that's my take on it. I'd like to see a healthy and vibrant community. I suspect the rest of you would enjoy the same or you'd probably not be visiting Voat and, almost certainly, not visiting this little tiny subversion inside Voat. It's not like you'll be embarrassed by posting - look at the silliness I write. You can, almost certainly, do better than I do just by randomly pecking at your keyboard with your cat's paws.

Hell, post pictures of your cat. Let your cat make a post - you might have to sign it for them. Get your cat to dance to a goat roping tune and upload a video of your cat gyrating to country music. If you do something creative, share. If anyone is mean about it we can join together and make fun of them for being jerks in an otherwise nice sub. I really think that posting content will help get more people to post more content and I intend to continue posting content until I either lose interest or am out of time to do so.
